title: Six LLMs trade $10k each live on crypto markets; only two finish in profit
summary: Nof1's Alpha Arena gave six frontier models $10,000 each to trade crypto perpetuals on Hyperliquid with no human intervention, a public test of LLMs as autonomous trading agents.
model: Qwen 3 Max, DeepSeek, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Grok, GPT-5
agent_role: Each model decided and executed its own trades on live markets; organizers set the prompts and rules and did not intervene during the season.
outcome: Qwen 3 Max finished first at $12,231 and DeepSeek second at $10,489; the other four models ended with large losses

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
